title: Senior Technical Consultant, HRSD / GBS ServiceNow - (Global role)
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI\-powered, secure, end\-to\-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

  



With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  

A trusted partner in operating complex and mission\-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

  


**About Atos Group**



Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7\.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands \- Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

### **Senior Technical Consultant – ServiceNow HRSD / GBS (Global Role)**

  


We are seeking an experienced **ServiceNow HRSD / Global Business Services (GBS) Technical Consultant** to join our global ServiceNow practice. This is a strategic, customer\-facing role focused on designing and delivering enterprise\-scale HRSD solutions, AI\-powered employee experiences, intelligent workflows, and shared\-service transformation initiatives for global organizations.



Working closely with CTO leadership, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, and global delivery teams, you will help shape next\-generation ServiceNow offerings while driving complex digital transformation programs across multiple geographies.

### 


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of ServiceNow HRSD solutions from design through deployment and support.
* Configure and implement HRSD capabilities including:
	+ HR Case \& Knowledge Management
	+ Employee Center / Employee Center Pro
	+ Enterprise Onboarding \& Transitions
	+ Lifecycle Events
	+ Universal Request
	+ Virtual Agent
* Design scalable employee journeys and shared\-service workflows supporting global operations.
* Develop integrations with HRIS, payroll, identity, document management, and enterprise platforms.
* Collaborate with HR, GBS, legal, privacy, compliance, security, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide technical design guidance, solution governance, best practices, and architectural recommendations.
* Drive automation, AI\-enabled experiences, reusable accelerators, and continuous platform innovation.
* Mentor technical teams and support pre\-sales, solution shaping, and customer workshops.


### **Required Qualifications**


* Current ServiceNow HRSD certification (CIS\-HR or equivalent).
* Certified Application Developer (CAD) or equivalent development expertise.
* 8\+ years of enterprise application or HR technology experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow platform experience.
* 3\+ years of direct ServiceNow HRSD implementation experience.
* Proven delivery of multiple enterprise\-scale HRSD implementations.
* Strong experience with:
	+ Flow Designer
	+ IntegrationHub
	+ JavaScript \& Glide APIs
	+ REST/SOAP Integrations
	+ Import Sets \& Transform Maps
	+ Security, Access Controls, and Data Privacy
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Prior consulting experience in complex enterprise environments.


### **Preferred Qualifications**


* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CIS, CAD, IntegrationHub, ITSM, CSM).
* Experience with Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or other HR platforms.
* Exposure to Global Business Services (GBS) and shared\-service transformations.
* Experience working within large multinational and regulated organizations.


### **Why Join Us?**


* Work on **global transformation programs** and strategic ServiceNow initiatives.
* Partner closely with senior leadership and CTO\-led innovation teams.
* Deliver **AI\-powered employee experience solutions** for enterprise customers worldwide.
* Influence the future of our global ServiceNow HRSD and GBS consulting practice.

  



Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.



Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.


**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

### **Senior Technical Consultant – Risk \& Security \- ServiceNow \- (Global Role)**

  



We are seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Risk \& Security Consultant** to design, implement, and enhance enterprise\-scale **ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Security Operations (SecOps)** solutions. In this global role, you will work closely with senior business and security leaders to deliver secure, scalable, AI\-enabled solutions that help organizations strengthen risk, compliance, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.

  


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of ServiceNow GRC/IRM and SecOps solutions from discovery through deployment and support.
* Configure and implement capabilities across Risk Management, Policy \& Compliance, Audit Management, Operational Risk, Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response, and Threat Intelligence.
* Design scalable workflows, integrations, dashboards, reporting, and automation aligned with ServiceNow best practices.
* Collaborate with architects, CISOs, risk and compliance teams, SOC leaders, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Develop integrations with security, identity, CMDB, asset management, SIEM, SOAR, cloud, and enterprise platforms.
* Drive technical governance, solution quality, security compliance, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor teams and contribute to reusable accelerators, solution assets, and pre\-sales activities.


#### **Required Skills \& Experience**


* 5\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow experience, with strong expertise in **GRC/IRM and/or Security Operations**.
* Experience delivering multiple enterprise\-scale ServiceNow implementations.
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, cybersecurity, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise operating models.
* Solid ServiceNow development and integration skills including **JavaScript, Glide APIs, REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Import Sets, and Transform Maps**.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with CMDB, identity systems, vulnerability scanners, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and security tools.
* Proven ability to engage and communicate effectively with executives, security leaders, and technical stakeholders.


#### **C****ertifications**


* Mandatory: Relevant ServiceNow certifications such as:
	+ CIS – Risk \& Compliance
	+ CIS – Security Incident Response
	+ CIS – Vulnerability Response
* Minimum of **3 ServiceNow CIS certifications** preferred.
* **ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA)** is highly desirable.


#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Additional certifications such as CSA, CAD, CISSP, CISM, CEH, Security\+, or equivalent.
* Experience with frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, GDPR, and related standards.
* Prior consulting and technical leadership experience.


#### **What Success Looks Like**


* Deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Improve risk visibility, compliance effectiveness, incident response, and vulnerability management outcomes.
* Build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders while driving business value through intelligent automation and innovation.

title: Presales Executive- IT
description:
**The Lead Calling Executive is responsible for contacting potential customers, qualifying leads, understanding customer requirements, scheduling meetings for the sales team, and maintaining accurate records in the CRM. The role focuses on converting inquiries into qualified business opportunities.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Make outbound calls to leads generated through IndiaMART, TradeIndia, GeM, website, social media, and marketing campaigns.**

**Handle inbound inquiries professionally and promptly.**

**Understand customer requirements and qualify leads based on business potential.**

**Schedule meetings or product demonstrations for the sales team.**

**Follow up with prospects regularly until they are converted or closed.**

**Update customer interactions, lead status, and follow\-up schedules in the CRM.**

**Coordinate with the sales team to ensure timely responses and quotations.**

**Maintain daily call reports and lead conversion records.**

**Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling and lead generation targets.**

**Build positive relationships with prospective customers.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
